sources.supports: Lower-fat yogurt has a higher curdling risk when heated; use higher-fat yogurt or reviewed stabilization. Yogurt substitutions are not universal one-for-one.
sources.application: Require whole-milk plain Greek yogurt for the three existing hot savory scopes; lower-fat remains available in pantry but unreviewed for those methods.

sources.supports: Add yogurt late, warm gradually and stir gently in hot dishes.
sources.application: Exact off-heat/gradual-tempering finish patches for soup and curry; this is a scoped cooking decision, not proof that all substitutions perform identically.

sources.supports: Fresh and low-moisture mozzarella have different moisture release and preparation/handling.
sources.application: Separate fresh and low-moisture identities; generic mozzarella text cannot establish either. No current recipe permissions are proposed for mozzarella.

sources.supports: Poultry and meat/poultry casseroles require 165°F on a thermometer.
sources.application: Add the missing thermometer endpoint to the chicken casserole while editing its binder method.
